lead: A `-p <crate>` check is impossible rather than unwritten when that crate's `Cargo.toml` does not name the crate owning the surface.
body: `crates/nvs-server/Cargo.toml` names no `nvs-stdlib`, so a check there about `files()` can never run. Read `crates/<crate>/Cargo.toml`'s `[dependencies]` first; adding a dev-dependency to make the filing true puts the test one layer above the rule it asserts.
